Learn by Making

Coding Workshops for Schools

Builds Your Mind runs project-based coding workshops for school students. Students learn programming by making real things, rather than working through exercises with no output.

A coding workshop for schools works best when there is something to show at the end. This coding education for schools is built around that idea.

Enquire About a Coding Workshop See all workshops

What Students Learn

Students start with the basics and finish with a working project.

Instructions, order and what happens when they are wrong

Repeating steps instead of writing them out again

Making a decision in code: if this, then that

Testing and fixing until it works

Project Examples

Every group works towards something they can run and show.

A simple game or quiz

An animation with a clear sequence

A small tool that reacts to what the user enters

A project that controls something built by hand

Age Groups

The project and the explanation change with the age of the group.

Primary classes: block-based coding with guided steps

Middle school: projects with their own rules and decisions

Senior school: text-based coding and open tasks

Link with Robotics and IoT

Coding is more convincing when it moves something. These sessions connect directly to our other workshops.

Program the robot you build in a robotics workshop

Read a sensor and act on it in an IoT project

Take a project from the screen to something physical

FAQs

The questions schools ask us most often before booking.

Do students need coding experience?

No. Activities start from the basics, and the group works at a pace that suits the class.

Do you need a computer lab?

For some sessions, yes. Tell us what your school has on the enquiry page and we will plan the session around it.

Which age groups can join?

Primary, middle and senior groups, with the project and the tool matched to the age of the students.

Can coding be combined with robotics?

Yes. Coding connects directly to our robotics and IoT workshops, so students can program something they have built.

How do we book a coding workshop?

Send your institution details through the enquiry page. A programme advisor will get back to you to plan the session.
